gloss: to wake up, to get up

definitions.gloss: to wake up, to get up
definitions.explanation: Used when someone wakes from sleep and gets out of bed. Can also mean to happen or occur (for events).
Used for events, incidents, or phenomena that take place. Common in news and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}6{時|じ}に{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up at 6 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: まだ{起|お}きていますか？

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {起|お}こす (transitive, to wake someone up). Pattern: Xが{起|お}きる.

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {起|お}きている = 'is awake' (not 'is waking up'). This is important: まだ{起|お}きている means 'still awake.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{朝|あさ}{早|はや}く{起|お}きる (wake up early)
・〜{時|じ}に{起|お}きる (wake up at ~ o'clock)
・{事故|じこ}が{起|お}きる (an accident occurs - sense 2)
・{起|お}きていますか (are you awake?)

Opposite: {寝|ね}る (to sleep/go to bed).
